proposal.hypothesis: Mapping three targets to each thread should reuse each streamed source particle across three independent force accumulations. A 128-thread block keeps 384 logical outputs per block, matching the selected factor-two parent's tile size while testing a different coarsening factor. The additional accumulators may increase register pressure and reduce occupancy; prior factor-two candidates were slower than baseline and the measured factor-four candidate was slower still, so no speedup is assumed.

retained: Assign three output targets per thread at offsets 0, blockDim.x, and 2*blockDim.x, with separate force accumulators and self-interaction checks.
Load each source particle once per source-loop iteration and reuse its position and mass across valid targets; do not stage sources in shared memory.
Use 128 threads and 384 logical outputs per block, matching the parent tile size while changing the coarsening factor; bounds-check all targets to cover arbitrary N and final partial blocks.
